create_category.description: Create a category, optionally as a subcategory of another. The name must be unique among its siblings. Needs an admin API username. Discourse also creates the category's 'About' topic, which does not count towards its topic count.
create_category.name: create_category

parameters.description: The category's name, unique among its siblings.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The category's colour as six hex digits, with or without a leading #, such as 0088CC.
parameters.name: color

parameters.description: The colour of the category's name on its badge, as six hex digits. Usually FFFFFF on a dark colour.
parameters.name: text_color

parameters.description: Make this a subcategory of the chosen category. Leave empty for a top-level category.
parameters.name: parent_category_id

parameters.description: The part of the category's URL after /c/. Leave empty and Discourse derives one from the name.
parameters.name: slug

create_post.description: Reply in an existing topic with a Markdown body. Give a post number to reply to one post in particular rather than to the topic as a whole.

mock_response.name: Ada Lovelace
mock_response.raw: The 3.5 release ships today with **faster search**.

create_post.name: create_post

parameters.description: The topic to act on: its ID, or its URL on the forum such as https://forum.example.com/t/welcome/8.
parameters.name: topic_id

parameters.description: The post body, in Markdown. Discourse enforces a minimum length (20 characters by default).
parameters.name: raw

parameters.description: The number of the post within the topic to reply to (1 is the first post). Leave empty to reply to the topic.
parameters.name: reply_to_post_number

create_topic.description: Start a new topic with a title and a Markdown body, in a category or in the forum's default one. Returns the topic's first post; its 'topic_id' is the new topic. Give an external ID or an embed URL to link the topic to a record in another system.

mock_response.name: Ada Lovelace
mock_response.raw: The 3.5 release ships today with **faster search**.

create_topic.name: create_topic

parameters.description: The title. Discourse enforces a minimum length (15 characters by default) and refuses a title identical to an existing topic's.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: The post body, in Markdown. Discourse enforces a minimum length (20 characters by default).
parameters.name: raw

parameters.description: Where to post it. Leave empty for the forum's default category, if the forum allows uncategorised topics.
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.description: Give the topic this creation time instead of now, for imported content. Leave empty normally.
parameters.name: created_at

parameters.description: An ID from another system to associate with the topic, so it can be found again by that ID.
parameters.name: external_id

parameters.description: A page URL to associate with the topic, for using the forum as a comment thread for that page.
parameters.name: embed_url

delete_category.description: Delete a category. Discourse only allows this for a category with no topics and no subcategories - delete or move its topics first. Needs an admin API username.
delete_category.name: delete_category

parameters.description: The category to act on. Pick one, or paste a category ID or its URL on the forum.
parameters.name: category_id

delete_post.description: Delete a post. Deleting a topic's first post deletes the whole topic. Staff can recover it for a while afterwards. Deleting another member's post needs a staff API username.
delete_post.name: delete_post

parameters.description: The post to act on, as the 'id' a create, get-topic or list step returned. This is the post's own ID, not its number within the topic.
parameters.name: post_id

delete_topic.description: Delete a topic and every post in it. Staff can recover it from the forum for a while afterwards; members cannot. The API username needs to be staff, or the topic's own author.
delete_topic.name: delete_topic

parameters.description: The topic to act on: its ID, or its URL on the forum such as https://forum.example.com/t/welcome/8.
parameters.name: topic_id

get_category.description: Read one category in full: its name, slug, colours, description, topic and post counts, parent, permissions and settings.
get_category.name: get_category

parameters.description: The category to act on. Pick one, or paste a category ID or its URL on the forum.
parameters.name: category_id

get_post.description: Read one post: its Markdown source and rendered HTML, author, topic, position in the topic, like and read counts, and whether it has been edited or hidden.

get_user.description: Read a member's profile: name, title, trust level, whether they are staff, post and topic counts, when they joined and were last seen, bio, groups, and their custom profile fields.

list_categories.description: List the forum's categories with each one's ID, name, slug, colours, topic and post counts, and parent. Tick 'Include subcategories' to get every subcategory too, flattened into the same list.

parameters.description: Include every subcategory in the list.

list_latest_posts.description: The newest posts across the whole forum, newest first, with each post's author, topic title, category and Markdown source. To read older ones, pass 'next_before' back as 'Before post ID'. Poll it to react to new posts.

items.name: Ada Lovelace
items.raw: The 3.5 release ships today with **faster search**.

list_latest_posts.name: list_latest_posts

parameters.description: Only posts with an ID lower than this - the 'next_before' a previous page returned.
parameters.name: before

returns.description: The newest posts across the forum, newest first

next_before.description: Pass this as 'before' to read the posts older than these, or empty when there are none

list_topics.description: List the forum's topics, most recently bumped first, or one category's. Each one reports its title, ID, slug, category, tags, post and view counts, whether it is closed or pinned, and when it was last posted in. Pick an order to sort by creation date, activity, views, posts or likes instead.
list_topics.name: list_topics

parameters.description: Limit this to one category. Pick one, or paste a category ID or its URL. Leave empty for the whole forum.
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.description: What to sort by. Defaults to most recently bumped.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: Reverse the order. Discourse lists newest or largest first by default.
parameters.name: ascending

parameters.description: Which page to read. Discourse counts topic pages from 0.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: How many to return, 1-100. Defaults to 30.
parameters.name: per_page

returns.description: The topics, in the order asked for

has_more.description: Whether the forum has another page

next_page.description: The page to ask for next, or empty at the end

list_users.description: List the forum's members from the admin panel: active, new, staff, suspended or silenced. Each one reports their username, name, trust level, join date, last visit and activity counts. Filter by email to find one member. 100 a page. Needs an admin API username.
list_users.name: list_users

parameters.description: Which member list to read. Defaults to active members.
parameters.name: flag

parameters.description: What to sort by. Defaults to Discourse's own order.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: Reverse the order. Discourse lists newest or largest first by default.
parameters.name: ascending

parameters.description: Only the member with this email address.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Fill in each member's email. Discourse records this in the staff action log.
parameters.name: show_emails

parameters.description: Which page to read. Defaults to the first.
parameters.name: page

has_more.description: Whether the page was full, so another may exist

search.description: Search the forum's posts, topics, members, categories and tags. The query takes Discourse's search language: 'in:title', '#category-slug', '@username', 'tags:name', 'after:2026-01-01', 'status:open'. Results come back grouped by kind, with the matched text of each post in 'blurb'.

posts.blurb: The 3.5 release ships today with faster search.

search.name: search

parameters.description: What to search for, with any of Discourse's search qualifiers.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: How to order the results. Defaults to relevance.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: Which page to read. Defaults to the first.
parameters.name: page

returns.description: Everything the forum matched, grouped by kind
